title: UK property market shows resilience six months into conflict
summary:
Six months into the US-Iran conflict, the UK property market has demonstrated greater resilience than initially forecast, according to recent market data and economic indicators. GDP growth of 0.4% in the quarter ending June 2026 and sustained buyer demand suggest the market has weathered the initial shock better than expected.

title: Subsidence claims jump 140% following record summer heat
summary:
UK insurers are reporting a significant increase in subsidence claims following the hottest summer on record, with Hastings Direct recording a near 140% jump in August claims. The average subsidence claim reached a record £20,000 between April and June, with total 2025 payouts hitting £297 million.

title: £11.7m finances 79-home County Durham development
summary:
Paragon Development Finance has provided £11.7 million in development finance to Wharfedale Homes for a 79-unit residential scheme in Gainford, County Durham. The 30-month facility supports a development with an anticipated gross development value of £24.3 million.

title: Five properties within walking distance of rail stations
summary:
Five residential properties located near railway stations across England have been listed for sale, with prices ranging from £450,000 to £1.25 million. The properties span locations from Oxford to Merseyside, with transport connectivity featuring prominently in the listings.

title: UK property sales remain above pre-Covid levels despite pricing pressures
summary:
The UK property market continues to operate above pre-pandemic levels despite a shift in market dynamics that has placed increased pressure on pricing strategies. Year-to-date figures show 832,000 homes have been sold subject to contract, representing a 5.7% increase compared to the 2017-2019 average.

title: Lettings agents face increased workload under new rental law
summary:
Three quarters of lettings professionals report increased administrative workload under the Renters' Rights Act, with compliance and record keeping cited as the primary contributors. New research reveals technology fragmentation and manual processes continue to hamper operational efficiency across the sector.

title: Rightmove launches rent review tool for lettings agents
summary:
Property portal Rightmove has introduced a rent review function to its Tenancy Manager platform, enabling lettings agents to process rent increases directly within the system. The new capability allows agents to create and serve Section 13 rent increase notices from existing tenancy records.

title: Former PM Brown warns against property tax increases
summary:
Former Prime Minister Gordon Brown has warned current PM Andy Burnham against increasing property taxes in the October Budget. Brown argued that property is already "taxed quite heavily" and called for reform of existing taxes rather than expansion.

title: Proptech firm launches rental pricing tool using rejection data
summary:
Proptech company nHabit has introduced a rental pricing tool that uses data on property rejections to help landlords and letting agents set rental prices more accurately. The launch comes as new legislation prohibits accepting rental offers above advertised prices.

title: Damp and structural issues deter 35% of property buyers
summary:
Damp or structural issues would prevent 35% of property buyers from making an offer, according to new research from estate agency brand LRG. The findings place damp and structural concerns joint third among the most common reasons buyers cite for not proceeding with a purchase.
